title: Why did Takara Holdings sell Takara Logistics System? [Explanation]
Takara : Notice Regarding the Transfer of Shares of a Consolidated Subsidiary and the Recognition of Extraordinary Income
Chuo Warehouse Co.,Ltd. entered into a share transfer agreement to acquire 70% stake in Takara Butsuryu System Co., Ltd. from Takara Holdings Inc. for ¥6.0 billion.
